mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has collapsed from -19.0% to -46.4% then partially recovered to -23.1%, signaling severe disruption to commuting patterns. This sustained workplace suppression directly reduces weekday retail foot traffic and consumer spending, driving RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES declined from -19.0% to -46.4% over three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the mean of the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES remaining below -20% for the entire forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station usage has contracted sharply from -27.4% to -48.6%, indicating severe mobility constraints. When transit falls below -40%, consumers cannot access retail destinations efficiently, suppressing RETAIL_REC independent of demand. Recovery requires TRANSIT to rise above -30%.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -40% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -48.6% in t-1w, -34.1% in t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -25% within two weeks AND RETAIL_REC increases by more than 5 percentage points, contradicting the supply-side constraint mechanism.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has stabilized near -17.4% after declining to -21.1%, indicating outdoor recreation substitution for indoor retail. This persistent outdoor preference, combined with RESIDENTIAL elevation at +12.1%, signals sustained home-centered behavior that suppresses RETAIL_REC recovery.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -17.4%, RESIDENTIAL at +12.1% in t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility rises above -5% while RESIDENTIAL falls below +5% AND RETAIL_REC increases by more than 8 percentage points over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has stabilized near -0.3% after declining to -4.1%, indicating essential shopping is maintained while discretionary retail remains suppressed at -35.4%. This divergence signals policy-driven category restrictions. If GROCERY_PHARM remains near zero while RETAIL_REC stays below -30%, restrictions remain in force.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM above -2% AND RETAIL_REC below -30% simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at -0.3%, RETAIL_REC at -35.4% in t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -5% while RETAIL_REC rises above -20% within one week, indicating restriction removal across all categories.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has risen monotonically from +8.7% to +18.3% then settled at +12.1%, indicating sustained home confinement. This four-week trend of elevated residential time is a leading indicator of suppressed retail demand. Continued RESIDENTIAL elevation above +10% predicts RETAIL_REC remains below -30%.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +10% for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from +8.7% to +18.3% over three weeks, now +12.1%
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +8% while RETAIL_REC increases by more than 10 percentage points over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has recovered from -48.6% to -34.1% week-on-week, a 14.5-point improvement. If this recovery continues at 5+ points per week for two weeks, commuting capacity will restore, enabling retail access. RETAIL_REC will rise as transit supply constraint eases.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by 5+ percentage points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 14.5 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT rises above -25% for two consecutive weeks AND RETAIL_REC remains below -30%, indicating demand-side suppression overrides supply recovery.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT show synchronized collapse (both at -46% to -48% in t-1w), indicating coordinated lockdown. If both series recover simultaneously above -25% within two weeks, it signals coordinated reopening that restores both commuting and retail activity, lifting RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise above -25% in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:Both series collapsed to -46% to -48% in t-1w
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both exceed -25% AND RETAIL_REC remains below -30% for two consecutive weeks, indicating retail remains restricted despite mobility recovery.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at -35.4% after declining to -37.1%, indicating a floor effect from binding restrictions. GROCERY_PHARM near zero and PARKS near -17% suggest selective reopening of essentials and outdoors. RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed unless GROCERY_PHARM falls sharply (indicating full reopening) or PARKS rises above -5% (indicating restriction relaxation).
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains between -2% and +2% AND PARKS remains between -20% and -10%
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC stabilized at -35.4%, GROCERY_PHARM at -0.3%, PARKS at -17.4%
regime_hint: tightening restrictions with selective category reopening
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -5% OR PARKS rises above -5% AND RETAIL_REC increases by more than 12 percentage points within four weeks.
